verdict.probe_answer: The memo matches the settled outcome: it recommends the import-binding/path-narrowing rung for bare calls after local resolution and before FreeMulti, Exact only when resolution narrows to one candidate. It also explicitly rejects same-directory/same-package Exact as unsound for Python because co-location is not scope. The only mild mismatch is sizing/coverage confidence: it describes Py/JS/TS intent and a small implementation, while the landed history needed Python-only hardening, but the memo's core shape and fail-open caveats were the vindicated design.
verdict.rationale: Full credit. The memo would have steered the team away from the naive Go-style same-directory preference and toward the import-qualified narrowing that landed, including the decisive guards: use import bindings, resolve paths, fall through on miss/external/multiple candidates, and avoid raising multi-target Exact canaries.
